text.tspan: Share of children enrolled in pre-primary school
Shown as the gross enrollment ratio — the number of children, regardless of their age, who are enrolled in
pre-primary education, expressed as a percentage of the population of pre-primary school age (typically 3–5
Data source: UNESCO Institute for Statistics (UIS), via World Bank (2026)
Note: Values may exceed 100% when children who are older or younger than the official age group also enroll.
